data.description: Interesting that I put a one star…
data.content:
* * *

## [Interesting that I put a one star…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/65cf8aa4b913a5789527d2f4)

The response below backs up my complaint. To review “internally”, my review, shows they will not publish the review. And reimbursing for delivery and install did not fix the problem. They should allow me to return the bed when the quality is this terrible. But I have seen all the bad reviews on other sites and the BBB, so I guess I shouldn’t be surprised. Very disappointing. They never even offered to send another installer to check the bed. They want the easiest and least responsible response for themselves, apparently.

“Interesting” that I put a one star review on their site, and they responded via email, but the review never posted. I have read this has happened to others. Hmmmmm...

Beware and read review from other sites, plus the multitude of BBB complaints, most of which do not get settled satisfactorily. They don't stand behind their product quality issues, always ask for pictures...even of missing parts, etc...shouldn't they know the parts that go with a product?? They only respond via email and won't accept a return after, I think, 45 days. The bed I bought was assembled improperly by the delivery company they hired. Screws stripped, pieces installed upside down and in the wrong configuration, missing leg support and many missing screws. It started creaking and moving/loosening. I sent pics as requested. They refunded the delivery fee. I bought hardware to try to fix the problem...they wanted pics of the leg and screws? that were missing? I put the bed back together properly, and it just can't be effectively tightened down, so either poor quality or messed up from the installers and can't be remedied. I've had the bed less than a year....this problem started a few months after getting the bed. I've tried working via email with the company, filed a BBB complaint, wrote review on their site, which they never published. Good luck if you buy something from them....

November 15, 2023

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Feb 16, 2024

Hi Tara, we are so incredibly sorry to hear about the quality issues associated with the assembly of the bed. Apologies if your purchase did not meet your expectations. We can see you corresponded with our Customer Experience team, and they issued a refund for the White Glove service. Our website underwent some recent changes, which involved our product reviews. We understand how important they can be and we'll be sure to share this feedback internally. We are available on Live Chat Monday-Friday 9am-5pm PST and we also offer scheduled phone call backs, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
